sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin, and I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶时代的夜店当DJ的时候，每晚你都要带上300张你最珍爱的藏品

sentences.en: to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful
sentences.zh: 去工作，你把DJ台变成了一个像是由精美绝伦的

sentences.en: 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 50年历史艺术品组成的微型快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the president's border wall has stood as the ultimate symbol of a hard-line approach to immigration, built on keeping people out.
sentences.zh: 今天，总统的边境墙一直是强硬移民政策的终极象征，其建立的初衷就是把人拒之门外。

sentences.en: So why, as Congress votes to end a shutdown and take up the issue of immigration, have Democrats suggested that if Republicans protect the dreamers, they would fund the wall.
sentences.zh: 那么为什么在国会投票结束政府关门并着手处理移民问题时，民主党人却暗示，如果共和党人保护“梦想生”，他们就会为修墙提供资金？

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, January 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月23日，星期二。

sentences.en: Julie, where does the idea of a border wall between the United States and Mexico come from?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，美国和墨西哥之间要修建边境墙这个想法是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: Well, the idea of border security has been a part of the immigration conversation for a long time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，加强边境安全这个想法在很长一段时间里都是移民话题的一部分。

sentences.en: Julie Davis covers the White House for The Times.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·戴维斯为《时报》报道白宫新闻。

sentences.en: But for Donald Trump, he started actually thinking about this even before he decided to jump into the
sentences.zh: 但对于唐纳德·特朗普来说，他甚至在决定参加总统竞选之前就开始认真考虑这件事了，当时他的几位顾问对他说，

sentences.en: presidential race when a couple of his advisors said that they thought it would be good for him to start talking about the idea of a border wall.
sentences.zh: 他们认为开始谈论修建边境墙的想法对他会很有利。

sentences.en: You know, they talk about, oh, I don't know, how could we possibly build a fence that nobody can climb over?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们讨论着，哦，我不知道，我们究竟怎样才能造出一道谁也翻不过去的栅栏呢？

sentences.en: I would build a border like you've never seen before.
sentences.zh: 我要修建一个你从未见过的边境。

sentences.en: Nobody's climbing over.
sentences.zh: 没有人能翻过去。

sentences.en: And he started testing it out.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始试水这个想法。

sentences.en: We have to build a fence.
sentences.zh: 我们必须修建一道栅栏。

sentences.en: Early in 2014, he said something along the lines of, I would build a border fence like you've never seen before.
sentences.zh: 在2014年初，他发表了类似这样的大意：我要修建一道你从未见过的边境栅栏。

sentences.en: And the crowd liked it, and he got kind of a warm response.
sentences.zh: 群众很喜欢，他也得到了相当热烈的反响。

sentences.en: Fences are easy, believe me.
sentences.zh: 栅栏很容易，相信我。

sentences.en: But then he started actually talking about a wall.
sentences.zh: 但随后他开始真正谈论起一堵墙。

sentences.en: And I would build a wall like nobody can build a wall.
sentences.zh: 我要修建一堵谁也建不出来的墙。

sentences.en: And nobody comes in illegally anymore.
sentences.zh: 从此再也没有人能非法入境。

sentences.en: When he started to talk about a wall and a strong wall, a solid wall, he found it was even more powerful.
sentences.zh: 当他开始谈论墙，一堵坚固的墙、结实的墙时，他发现这种说法更有力量。

sentences.en: And it began to be a staple of all of his speeches to political audiences.
sentences.zh: 这开始成为他面对政治听众时所有演讲的标配。

sentences.en: And I would build the greatest wall you have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 我要修建你见过的最伟大的墙。

sentences.en: And then, of course, he really hit it hard in his announcement speech for his campaign.
sentences.zh: 当然，后来在竞选宣布大会上，他真的狠狠地强调了这一点。

sentences.en: I would build a great wall.
sentences.zh: 我要修建一堵伟大的墙。

sentences.en: And nobody builds walls better than me, believe me.
sentences.zh: 没有人比我更擅长建墙，相信我。

sentences.en: And it became a rallying cry at rallies around the country when his presidential campaign got underway.
sentences.zh: 当他的总统竞选全面展开时，这成了全国各地集会上的一呼百应的口号。

sentences.en: Build that wall.
sentences.zh: 修那堵墙。

sentences.en: We're going to build that wall.
sentences.zh: 我们要修那堵墙。

sentences.en: Don't worry about it.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: And he used to say privately that when he felt like a crowd was starting to lag or lose some energy
sentences.zh: 他过去常常私下里说，每当他觉得现场气氛开始沉闷或失去一些活力，

sentences.en: or he really needed, like, a big applause line, he would start talking about the wall and people would just eat it up.
sentences.zh: 或者他真的很需要像热烈鼓掌那样的高潮时，他就会开始谈论修墙，而大家对此总是乐此不疲。

sentences.en: We will build a wall.
sentences.zh: 我们将建造一堵墙。

sentences.en: And if you listen to the response at some of these rallies...
sentences.zh: 如果你听听其中一些集会上的反应……

sentences.en: We will 100% build the wall.
sentences.zh: 我们将100%建起这堵墙。

sentences.en: He was really right.
sentences.zh: 他确实说对了。

sentences.en: And the more he said it and the more it got a rise out of Democrats and the left.
sentences.zh: 他说得越多，越能激起民主党人和左翼人士的强烈反应。

sentences.en: This is just one more example of something that is not thought through and is primarily put forward for political consumption.
sentences.zh: 这只是又一个未经深思熟虑的例证，其提出主要是为了迎合政治需求。

sentences.en: He would double down on that and people ate it up even more.
sentences.zh: 他会变本加厉地坚持这一点，而人们对此更加买账。

sentences.en: Donald Trump wants to build a wall.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普想要修建一堵墙。

sentences.en: Secretary Clinton wants to put together a pathway for success, for citizenship, for 11 million folks.
sentences.zh: 克林顿国务卿想要为11万民众制定一条成功和获得公民身份的途径。

sentences.en: Is that important to you?
sentences.zh: 这对你很重要吗？

sentences.en: Democrats around the country start talking about how awful this concept is of a wall and building barriers between our country and other countries.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的民主党人开始讨论这种筑墙以及在我们的国家与其他国家之间建立屏障的概念是多么糟糕。

sentences.en: We believe that black lives matter and that we won't build Donald Trump's stupid wall.
sentences.zh: 我们坚信黑人的命也是命，我们绝不会修建唐纳德·特朗普那愚蠢的墙。

sentences.en: And Hillary Clinton starts to ridicule the idea.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿开始嘲笑这个想法。

sentences.en: We build bridges, not walls.
sentences.zh: 我们要建桥，而不是筑墙。

sentences.en: And at this point, Donald Trump has started to talk about Mexico is going to pay for the wall and she shoots down that idea.
sentences.zh: 此时，唐纳德·特朗普开始谈论由墨西哥为这堵墙买单，而她则断然拒绝了这个想法。

sentences.en: By the way, Mexico is not paying for his wall either.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，墨西哥也不会为他的墙买单。

sentences.en: If he ever tries to get it built, the American taxpayer will pay for it.
sentences.zh: 如果他真能把墙建起来，美国纳税人将为此付账。

sentences.en: And so for the Democrats, it becomes a symbol of everything that they criticize about Trump.
sentences.zh: 因此，对民主党人来说，这成了他们批判特朗普的一切事物的象征。

sentences.en: For him, it's all about walls.
sentences.zh: 对他而言，一切都关乎墙。

sentences.en: It's not about that for us.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说可不是这样。

sentences.en: And that became a real point of contrast for the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 这成了民主党人一个真正的鲜明对比点。

sentences.en: I'm pleased that you all are here to witness the signature of the Secure Fence Act of 2006.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴大家能在这里见证《2006年安全栅栏法案》的签署。

sentences.en: You have to remember that Hillary Clinton and actually many Senate Democrats voted in 2006 for some pretty elaborate fencing at the border.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，希拉里·克林顿以及实际上许多参议院民主党人在2006年都曾投票支持在边境修建相当复杂的栅栏。

sentences.en: For months, Democrats and Republicans have been working together to pass a comprehensive immigration bill out of this Congress.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，民主党人和共和党人一直在合作，以期在本届国会通过一项全面的移民法案。

sentences.en: And so that's something that Hillary Clinton had been in favor of.
sentences.zh: 所以这是希拉里·克林顿曾经赞成的事情。

sentences.en: Chuck Schumer, Barack Obama had voted in favor of it.
sentences.zh: 查克·舒默、巴拉克·奥巴马都曾投票赞成。

sentences.en: And this was around the time when they were talking about a broader immigration compromise.
sentences.zh: 这正是在他们讨论更广泛的移民妥协方案的时候。

sentences.en: Because we know that in addition to greater border security, we also need greater sanctions on employers who hire people in this country illegally.
sentences.zh: 因为我们知道，除了加强边境安全，我们还需要加大对雇佣非法入境人员的雇主的惩罚力度。

sentences.en: But now you have a Republican candidate, Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 但现在你迎来了一位共和党候选人，唐纳德·特朗普，

sentences.en: who's talking about a wall and who's made it about this physical solid barrier that has become a symbol of a very exclusionary immigration policy.
sentences.zh: 他一直在谈论一堵墙，并将其打造成一种坚固的实体屏障，这已经成为极具排他性的移民政策的象征。

sentences.en: And so all of a sudden, that's not something Democrats want to agree to anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，这不再是民主党人愿意同意的事情了。

sentences.en: It's not something they want to be seen as in any way supportive of.
sentences.zh: 这不是他们希望被认为以任何方式支持的事情。

sentences.en: And so you effectively sort of removed the entire conversation about, well, what is prudent border security?
sentences.zh: 因此，你实际上等于抹杀了关于“究竟什么是审慎的边境安全”的整个讨论。

sentences.en: Because all Donald Trump is talking about is a wall.
sentences.zh: 因为唐纳德·特朗普满嘴谈论的都只有墙。

sentences.en: Is that how Trump himself saw the wall as more of a symbol and a metaphor?
sentences.zh: 特朗普本人就是这样看待这堵墙的吗？将其更多地视为一种象征和隐喻？

sentences.en: Or did he actually want to build a physical wall along the border with Mexico?
sentences.zh: 还是他真的想在与墨西哥的边境沿线修建一堵实体墙？

sentences.en: It's an interesting question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有趣的问题。

sentences.en: I think he was enamored with the idea of it, with the imagery of it.
sentences.zh: 我认为他迷恋这个想法，迷恋它的视觉形象。

sentences.en: But he also, frankly, didn't have very and still does not have very detailed understanding of the policy issues on immigration.
sentences.zh: 但坦率地说，他过去对、现在对移民政策议题也没有非常深入的理解。

sentences.en: But a wall, he could understand.
sentences.zh: 不过墙这件事，他是能理解的。

sentences.en: And he would even say at some of his rallies, I'm a builder.
sentences.zh: 他甚至在一些集会上说，我是个建筑商。

sentences.en: I know how to build things.
sentences.zh: 我知道怎么建造东西。

sentences.en: It was sort of a comfortable place for him to be as a person who didn't understand the nuances of immigration policy.
sentences.zh: 对于一个不懂移民政策细微差别的人来说，这算是一个让他感到舒适的领域。

sentences.en: Didn't much care to do any sort of detailed research into how you actually get to a comprehensive immigration bill.
sentences.zh: 他并不太在意去做任何详细的研究，去了解如何才能真正达成一项全面的移民法案。

sentences.en: He got himself to a place where he really couldn't let go of it.
sentences.zh: 他把自己带到了一个真正无法释怀的境地。

sentences.en: So President Trump is elected in part, you could argue, because of the promise that he would build this wall.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普总统当选，可以说在一定程度上是因为他承诺要修建这堵墙。

sentences.en: And this is a moment when people begin to wonder to what extent his campaign rhetoric is just rhetoric and to what extent it's real.
sentences.zh: 而此时人们开始好奇，他的竞选言辞究竟有多少只是空谈，又有多少会成为现实。

sentences.en: And the president signals early on that he's serious in all kinds of ways when it comes to immigration.
sentences.zh: 总统从一开始就在移民问题上通过各种方式释放出他是认真的信号。

sentences.en: There's the travel ban.
sentences.zh: 先是旅行禁令。

sentences.en: He cracks down on deportations and detainments of undocumented immigrants.
sentences.zh: 他加大力度打击无证移民的驱逐出境和拘留。

sentences.en: What happens, though, with the wall?
sentences.zh: 然而，这堵墙又该如何呢？

sentences.en: Does he actually try to get the wall built?
sentences.zh: 他真的试图把墙建起来吗？

sentences.en: Well, beginning today, the United States of America gets back control of its borders, gets back its borders.
sentences.zh: 好吧，从今天开始，美利坚合众国重新夺回对其边境的控制权，重新夺回它的边境。

sentences.en: Early on, he issues an executive order in which he says,
sentences.zh: 早期，他发布了一项行政命令，其中表示：

sentences.en: The Secretary of Homeland Security, working with myself and my staff, will begin immediate construction of a border wall.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部部长将与我和我的团队合作，立即开始修建边境墙。

sentences.en: And we all looked at this executive order and we're paging through all the pages.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都看着这份行政命令，一页一页地翻找着。

sentences.en: And where is the part where he orders this wall and requests appropriations or money to spend to actually begin building this wall?
sentences.zh: 他下令修建这堵墙并要求拨款或批钱来真正开始建墙的部分在哪里？

sentences.en: And it's nowhere because he and his advisers have realized that you actually need Congress to provide the money to build a wall.
sentences.zh: 根本找不到，因为他和他的顾问们已经意识到，你实际上需要国会来提供资金才能建墙。

sentences.en: And Republicans in Congress signal that this is not high on their priority liSt.
sentences.zh: 而国会中的共和党人则发出信号，表明这不是他们优先事项清单上的重点。

sentences.en: They have a lot of things to do to keep the government running.
sentences.zh: 他们有很多事情要做，以维持政府运转。

sentences.en: And, you know, allocating billions of dollars for a border wall is just not at the top of their liSt.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，为边境墙划拨数十亿美元根本不在他们清单的前列。

sentences.en: So the logistics of turning this very successful campaign symbol into a governing reality turns out to be very complicated.
sentences.zh: 因此，将这个极其成功的竞选符号转化为治理现实的后勤工作，结果证明是非常复杂的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that becomes apparent the first time the president has to sign a bill to keep the government funded in the spring of 2017.
sentences.zh: 当总统在2017年春季不得不签署一项法案以维持政府资金运转时，这一点变得显而易见。

sentences.en: President Trump will mark his 100th day in office this week.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统本周将迎来他上任的第100天。

sentences.en: But first, he'll need to work with Congress to keep the government funded.
sentences.zh: 但首先，他需要与国会合作以保持政府资金不断裂。

sentences.en: And the issue of who will fund the border wall could be holding things up.
sentences.zh: 而谁来资助边境墙的问题可能会耽误进程。

sentences.en: Trump tweeting this morning, quote,
sentences.zh: 特朗普今天早上发推文称，引述：

sentences.en: The Democrats don't want money from budget going to border wall despite the fact that it will stop drugs and very bad MS-13 gang members.
sentences.zh: 尽管边境墙能阻止毒品和极度危险的MS-13帮派成员，但民主党人仍然不希望预算资金流向边境墙。

sentences.en: And the president has said he wants money in that package for the beginnings of a border wall.
sentences.zh: 总统曾表示，他希望在该打包法案中包含用于修建边境墙启动资金的款项。

sentences.en: One of the things holding up the spending bill was the president's insistence on funding for the southern border wall.
sentences.zh: 阻碍这项开支法案的因素之一就是总统坚持要为南部边境墙提供资金。

sentences.en: And now he's given in.
sentences.zh: 而现在他妥协了。

sentences.en: And when it comes down to it, Mitch McConnell cuts a deal with Democrats that does not include funding for a border wall, not even one cent for a border wall.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，米奇·麦康奈尔与民主党人达成了一项不包含边境墙资金的协议，甚至连一分钱的边境墙资金都没有。

sentences.en: The game of chicken between the White House and Democrats over government funding ended before it began.
sentences.zh: 白宫与民主党人之间关于政府资金的懦夫博弈在开始之前就结束了。

sentences.en: And the president has to swallow that and sign it.
sentences.zh: 总统不得不咽下这口气并将其签署。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In the end, it was a choice between fighting for that border wall funding and risking a government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这是在为边境墙资金斗争还是冒着政府关门风险之间做出的选择。

sentences.en: And the White House blinks.
sentences.zh: 而白宫退缩了。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: Why don't congressional Republicans want to fund this wall?
sentences.zh: 为什么国会共和党人不愿为这堵墙提供资金？

sentences.en: Is it because it's too objectionable to Democrats to stand any chance of making it into something as urgent as a budget bill?
sentences.zh: 是因为它对民主党人来说过于令人反感，以至于根本没有机会被塞进预算案这样紧迫的事情中吗？

sentences.en: Well, a few reasons.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有几个原因。

sentences.en: One of the reasons is that a wall of the kind that Trump was proposing is extremely expensive.
sentences.zh: 其中一个原因是，特朗普所提议的那种墙极其昂贵。

sentences.en: This is supposed to be the party of fiscal restraint.
sentences.zh: 这本该是主张财政紧缩的党派。

sentences.en: They're talking about spending caps and we have to pare back and reining in the deficit and the debt.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在谈论支出上限，我们必须削减开支并控制赤字与债务。

sentences.en: And so the idea of pouring billions of dollars into something like this is not particularly appealing to them.
sentences.zh: 因此，把数十亿美元倾注到这样的事情上的想法对他们来说并没有什么吸引力。

sentences.en: It might be if they thought it was practical.
sentences.zh: 如果他们认为这切实可行的话，也许还会有所吸引。

sentences.en: But even Republicans in Congress will tell you that they don't particularly think that one long physical barrier along the border is the way to go.
sentences.zh: 但即使是国会中的共和党人也会告诉你，他们并不认为沿着边境修建一道长长的实体屏障是明智之举。

sentences.en: And so they can't see their way clear to sticking hundreds of millions or billions of dollars into this budget bill for a wall when it's not clear that that's going to yield the kind of results that they want to see.
sentences.zh: 因此，当不确定这能否产生他们想要看到的效果时，他们无法说服自己将数亿或数十亿美元塞进这项预算案来修墙。

sentences.en: And how are Democrats in Congress reacting to the president trying to get this funding for the wall into the budget?
sentences.zh: 国会中的民主党人对总统试图将这笔建墙资金塞进预算有何反应？

sentences.en: Look, Democrats have always been for border security.
sentences.zh: 听着，民主党人一直都支持边境安全。

sentences.en: We just think the wall made no sense.
sentences.zh: 我们只是认为这堵墙毫无意义。

sentences.en: Well, from the very beginning, they said that it was a nonstarter.
sentences.zh: 好吧，从一开始，他们就表示这是不可接受的。

sentences.en: And we're not going to allow any dollars in any kind of border security appropriation to be used for a wall, period.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不允许任何边境安全拨款中的美元被用于修墙，就这样。

sentences.en: One of the things that they did after the budget deal was reached and there was no money for the wall in it was they crowed about it and it really got under Trump's skin.
sentences.zh: 在达成预算协议且其中没有包含建墙资金后，他们所做的事情之一就是大肆吹嘘，这真的戳到了特朗普的痛处。

sentences.en: And this is the line that people are talking about.
sentences.zh: 这就是人们正在热议的那句话。

sentences.en: Our country needs a good shutdown in September to fix mess.
sentences.zh: 我们国家需要在9月份来一次彻底的关门来收拾烂摊子。

sentences.en: The president of the United States just called for a government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 美国总统刚刚呼吁政府关门。

sentences.en: And it got under the skin of a lot of his aides at the White House who were trying to sort of explain away the fact that they just accepted a budget deal that didn't have wall funding in it.
sentences.zh: 这戳到了白宫许多助手们的痛处，他们原本正试图极力掩饰这样一个事实：他们刚刚接受了一项没有建墙资金的预算协议。

sentences.en: But really, he lost some face, you know, and the White House had to figure out what to do about that.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，他确实有些丢面子，你知道，白宫不得不琢磨该如何应对此事。

sentences.en: So the Trump administration is at this point trying to save face because they're not getting the wall that they want.
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普政府此时正在极力挽回面子，因为他们没有得到想要的墙。

sentences.en: So how exactly do they do that?
sentences.zh: 那么他们究竟是怎么做的呢？

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: Another busy day here at the White House.
sentences.zh: 白宫今天又是个忙碌的日子。

sentences.en: It got kind of crazy and absurd in the White House briefing room one day when Sean Spicer, the press secretary.
sentences.zh: 有一天在白宫新闻简报室里，当新闻秘书肖恩·斯派塞出现时，情况变得既疯狂又荒谬。

sentences.en: So if I can get a quick, the first image up, brought out these photographs of fencing and all sorts of barriers at the border.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我能快速调出第一张图片，拿出了这些边境栅栏和各种屏障的照片。

sentences.en: And this is what exists right now throughout our country.
sentences.zh: 这就是目前遍布我们全国的东西。

sentences.en: Went through all these pictures and said, you see, there are various types of walls that can be built under the legislation that was just passed.
sentences.zh: 他翻阅所有这些照片并说道，你看，根据刚刚通过的立法，可以建造各种类型的墙。

sentences.en: It allows us to do that.
sentences.zh: 这允许我们这样做。

sentences.en: This is called a bollard wall.
sentences.zh: 这被称为方桩墙。

sentences.en: We get this in the bill.
sentences.zh: 我们在法案里争取到了这个。

sentences.en: This is called the wall on the left.
sentences.zh: 左边这个被称为墙。

sentences.en: So that's not a wall.
sentences.zh: 所以那不是一堵墙。

sentences.en: It's a levee wall.
sentences.zh: 这是一堵防洪堤墙。

sentences.en: That's what it's actually called.
sentences.zh: 这才是它真正的名字。

sentences.en: And there was an exchange between him and the reporter from Breitbart, which has been very strong on demanding the wall and demanding wall funding.
sentences.zh: 他与布赖特巴特新闻网的记者之间有一段对话，该网一直极力主张修建墙并要求提供建墙资金。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不是的。

sentences.en: In this current bill.
sentences.zh: 在当前的这项法案中。

sentences.en: Where the reporter's kind of incredulous, like you're calling that a wall.
sentences.zh: 当时那名记者有点难以置信，就像是说“你居然管那叫墙”。

sentences.en: And Spicer's saying, well, it's a bollard wall.
sentences.zh: 而斯派塞则说，嗯，这是一堵隔离墩墙。

sentences.en: And that's that's bollard wall is a wall.
sentences.zh: 那就是——隔离墩墙就是一堵墙。

sentences.en: We have what was in the first slide.
sentences.zh: 我们有第一张幻灯片里的内容。

sentences.en: But it was very clear beginning then and it's become clear in the months since that, you know,
sentences.zh: 但在当时的一开始就非常清楚，而且在随后的几个月里也变得很清楚，那就是，你知道的，

sentences.en: the quote unquote wall is not necessarily a big poured concrete cement wall like Donald Trump talked about on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: 所谓的“墙”并不一定像唐纳德·特朗普在竞选集会上谈到的那样，是一堵用混凝土浇筑的大墙。

sentences.en: Well, they're very subtly and slowly moving toward, well, a wall could be a fence.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们正在非常微妙且缓慢地朝着这样一个方向转变：嗯，墙也可以是一道栅栏。

sentences.en: A wall could include surveillance.
sentences.zh: 墙可以包含监控设施。

sentences.en: A wall is not necessarily what people thought a wall was going to look like.
sentences.zh: 墙不一定长得像人们曾经认为的那样。

sentences.en: The president said he was going to build a wall and he's doing it.
sentences.zh: 总统曾说他要建一堵墙，而他正在这么做。

sentences.en: He's using the best technology and what the Department of Homeland Security under Secretary John Kelly says is the most effective way to keep people out, to stop drugs,
sentences.zh: 他正在使用最好的技术，以及国土安全部在代理部长约翰·凯利领导下所说的是阻挡人员、阻止毒品的最有效方法，

sentences.en: to stop cartels.
sentences.zh: 阻止贩毒集团。

sentences.en: This gets to something that John Kelly, Trump's chief of staff, talked about privately with some Democratic lawmakers and then later publicly in an interview last week,
sentences.zh: 这就涉及到了特朗普的幕僚长约翰·凯利上周与一些民主党议员私下讨论、随后又在一次采访中公开谈到的内容，

sentences.en: which is that campaign to governing are two different things.
sentences.zh: 那就是竞选和执政是两码事。

sentences.en: And this president is very, very, very flexible in terms of what is within the realm of the possible.
sentences.zh: 这位总统在可能性的范围内表现得非常、非常、非常灵活。

sentences.en: It's one thing to campaign for president and it's another thing to be president.
sentences.zh: 竞选总统是一回事，当总统又是另一回事。

sentences.en: And Trump essentially, he said, had to be educated on this.
sentences.zh: 特朗普基本上，他表示，在这方面需要接受教育。

sentences.en: You know, there's been an evolutionary process that this president has gone through as a campaign.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这位总统在竞选期间经历了一个演变过程。

sentences.en: And I pointed out to all of the members that were in the room that they all say things during the course of campaigns that may or may not be fully informed.
sentences.zh: 我向在场的每一位议员指出，他们在竞选过程中所说的话，有些可能信息充分，有些则未必。

sentences.en: And he's evolved, he said, on the issue of a wall and now understands what, frankly,
sentences.zh: 他说，他在建墙这个问题上已经演变了，现在坦率地明白了，

sentences.en: Kelly was saying early on when he was nominated to be the Homeland Security Secretary at his hearings that.
sentences.zh: 凯利在被提名担任国土安全部长并在听证会上早期所说的话。

sentences.en: If you were to build a wall from the Pacific to the Gulf of Mexico, you'd still have to back that wall up with patrolling by human beings, by sensors, by observation devices.
sentences.zh: 如果你从太平洋到墨西哥湾建一堵墙，你仍然需要人类巡逻、传感器和观测设备来为这堵墙提供后盾。

sentences.en: It's not going to look the way a wall might indicate.
sentences.zh: 它看起来不会像人们想象中墙的样子。

sentences.en: It's going to look like very sophisticated technology, fencing, see-through barriers and the like.
sentences.zh: 它看起来将是非常先进的技术、围栏、透明屏障之类东西的结合。

sentences.en: That's fascinating in what it tells us about the politics of the wall, that even John Kelly,
sentences.zh: 这在揭示有关建墙的政治博弈方面非常迷人，甚至连约翰·凯利——

sentences.en: who's the former Homeland Security Secretary and who we're now talking about as this figure who is pushing the president to the right on the issue of immigration, that he's saying,
sentences.zh: 他曾任国土安全部长，而现在我们讨论他是因为他是推动总统在移民问题上向右转的关键人物——他也表示，

sentences.en: well, it's not really a wall, folks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，伙计们，这其实不是一堵墙。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And you also have Democrats who have basically acknowledged since late last year that they may have to accept some level of border security beyond maybe what they're comfortable with in order to get some progress on the issues they care about,
sentences.zh: 而且民主党人从去年底开始也基本上承认，为了在他们关心的议题上取得进展，

sentences.en: like protections for dreamers and a broader immigration compromise later on.
sentences.zh: 比如对追梦人的保护以及稍后更广泛的移民妥协方案，他们可能不得不接受某种程度的、超出他们舒适区的边境安全措施。

sentences.en: And what they say privately, and in some cases publicly to the president's aides, is you want us to call it a wall?
sentences.zh: 他们在私下里，以及在某些情况下向总统的助手公开表示的是：你们想让我们叫它墙吗？

sentences.en: We can call it a wall.
sentences.zh: 我们可以叫它墙。

sentences.en: But this has to be part of a larger negotiation.
sentences.zh: 但这必须是更大规模谈判的一部分。

sentences.en: And what is clear is that the people around the president who are pushing a restrictive line on immigration have decided that the wall or fencing or border security,
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是，总统身边那些在移民问题上推动强硬路线的人已经断定，墙、围栏或边境安全——

sentences.en: however you want to put it, is not enough for them.
sentences.zh: 无论你怎么称呼它——对他们来说还不够。

sentences.en: So it sounds like what you're describing is the background and the backdrop to what happened on Friday in this meeting between Chuck Schumer and President Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来你所描述的是上周五查克·舒默与特朗普总统会晤的背景和前奏。

sentences.en: The president said many times he would take a deal that included DACA in exchange for the wall.
sentences.zh: 总统曾多次表示，他会接受一项包含DACA以换取建墙的协议。

sentences.en: I put that deal on the table in the Oval Office in a sincere effort at compromise.
sentences.zh: 我真诚地寻求妥协，将这项协议摆在了椭圆形办公室的桌面上。

sentences.en: The fact that the Senate Democratic leader is willing to fund the wall and make that part of the negotiation, I think that came as a huge surprise to most people.
sentences.zh: 参议院民主党领袖愿意为建墙提供资金并将其作为谈判的一部分，我认为这对大多数人来说是一个巨大的惊喜。

sentences.en: It seemed like the ultimate reversal for the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是民主党人的终极反转。

sentences.en: Right, except that you have to remember that we're in a period now where the Democrats feel like they're very close,
sentences.zh: 没错，不过你必须记住，我们现在处于这样一个时期：民主党人觉得自己非常接近——

sentences.en: perhaps on the brink of getting the president to agree to a broader immigration deal that they have long been pressing for.
sentences.zh: 也许正处于让总统同意他们长期以来一直力推的更广泛移民协议的边缘。

sentences.en: And this is a way of the Democrats putting it to the president.
sentences.zh: 这是民主党人向总统出牌的一种方式。

sentences.en: If you really want this deal, which we really want, we'll give you something that you really want that, P.S., we've actually voted for versions of many years ago to get it done.
sentences.zh: 如果你真的想要这份我们也很想要的协议，我们会给你一个你真正想要的东西，顺便说一句，我们多年前其实就曾为它的某些版本投过票以求达成。

sentences.en: I mean, you had one prominent Democrat on the House side, Luis Gutierrez, say.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，众议院的一位杰出民主党人路易斯·古铁雷斯曾说，

sentences.en: But if that's what it's going to take to take 800,000 young men and women and give them a chance to live freely and openly in America, then I'll roll up my sleeves.
sentences.zh: 但如果这就是让80万年轻男女获得在美国自由公开生活机会的代价，那么我会撸起袖子。

sentences.en: I'll go down there with bricks and mortar and begin the wall.
sentences.zh: 我会带着砖块和砂浆去那里开始建墙。

sentences.en: They're essentially saying this wall was always ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在说，这堵墙从一开始就很荒谬。

sentences.en: It was always something that we didn't support.
sentences.zh: 这从一开始就是我们不支持的东西。

sentences.en: But if you want to talk about border security in exchange for what we consider a good immigration deal, we'll do that.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想用边境安全来交换我们认为好的移民协议，我们会这么做。

sentences.en: And that can be the debate that we have.
sentences.zh: 这可以成为我们展开的辩论。

sentences.en: And it feels like what we're learning about Democrats is that it's far more objectionable and frustrating for them to negotiate away major elements of American immigration policy than it is to give away the wall.
sentences.zh: 感觉我们对民主党人的了解是，放弃美国移民政策的重要部分，比放弃这堵墙更令他们反感和沮丧。

sentences.en: In the end, a wall is just a physical structure.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，墙只是一种物理结构。

sentences.en: It did take on this huge symbolic significance during the campaign and during the first year of Trump's presidency.
sentences.zh: 它在竞选期间和特朗普总统任期的第一年确实具有了巨大的象征意义。

sentences.en: But the wall was never a policy.
sentences.zh: 但墙从来都不是一项政策。

sentences.en: And now that they're in a negotiation over what the real policy looks like,
sentences.zh: 现在他们正在就真正的政策是什么进行谈判，

sentences.en: I think both sides are trying to get to a place where they can put that to one side and figure out what they're both really willing to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为双方都在努力找到一个切入点，把那个问题搁置一旁，弄清楚他们双方究竟愿意做些什么。

sentences.en: And so that brings us to Monday.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了星期一。

sentences.en: And good evening tonight from Washington.
sentences.zh: 今晚从华盛顿向大家问好。

sentences.en: We are here in the nation's capital because of the government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以来到国家首都，是因为政府关门了。

sentences.en: Today was day three.
sentences.zh: 今天是第三天。

sentences.en: And then Senate Democrats deciding to give in on the DREAMers with the promise from Senate Republicans that they'll take up the issue soon.
sentences.zh: 然后参议院民主党人决定在追梦人问题上让步，条件是参议院共和党人承诺将很快审议这一问题。

sentences.en: Congress has just voted for this temporary funding bill with an agreement that they will have a full debate on immigration in the coming days.
sentences.zh: 国会刚刚投票通过了一项临时拨款法案，并达成协议，将在未来几天对移民问题进行全面辩论。

sentences.en: How should we think about this debate and what's likely to happen in this debate?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何看待这场辩论，以及这场辩论中可能会发生什么？

sentences.en: In light of what you've just told us about the real significance of the wall.
sentences.zh: 鉴于你刚才跟我们讲的关于墙的真正意义。

sentences.en: Where we are now is that it's very clear that President Trump and Democrats are going to spend the next three weeks getting into the nitty gritty of immigration policy.
sentences.zh: 我们现在所处的位置是，很显然特朗普总统和民主党人将在接下来的三周内深入探讨移民政策的细节。

sentences.en: And that the simple, stark reality of the wall is not going to be the dominant issue.
sentences.zh: 而墙那简单而严酷的现实将不再是主导议题。

sentences.en: It's going to be all of these other complicated issues that they never even really touched in the campaign and certainly not in this negotiation that led us to today.
sentences.zh: 将是所有这些在竞选期间甚至在导致我们走到今天的这场谈判中都未曾真正触及的其他复杂问题。

sentences.en: So we're finally going to have the complicated immigration reform debate that in many ways the wall sort of precluded up until now.
sentences.zh: 所以我们终于要进行那场复杂的移民改革辩论了，在很多方面，此前这堵墙在某种程度上阻碍了它的进行。

sentences.en: It seems like we will.
sentences.zh: 看起来我们会的。

sentences.en: The wall is clearly going to continue to be an element here, but there's a lot more to a compromise on immigration than just Donald Trump's wall.
sentences.zh: 墙显然仍将是这里的一个要素，但移民妥协方案的内容要丰富得多，绝不仅仅是唐纳德·特朗普的那堵墙。

sentences.en: Always a pleasure, Michael.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能跟你聊，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Monday afternoon, the Senate, then the House, passed a short-term spending bill to reopen the government and keep it funded through February 8th.
sentences.zh: 周一下午，参议院随后众议院通过了一项短期支出法案，以重新开放政府并维持其资金运转至2月8日。

sentences.en: Democrats joined Republicans in voting for the measure in exchange for a promise from Republican leaders that Congress would continue to negotiate a so-called global agreement on immigration that would include the fate of the dreamers.
sentences.zh: 民主党人加入共和党人的行列投票支持该法案，作为交换，共和党领袖承诺国会将继续就所谓的全面移民协议进行谈判，其中将包括追梦人的命运。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们去去就回。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店当DJ的时候，你每夜都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个充满生机的、精美的50年历史文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯DealBook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于nytimes.com上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: I have represented the United States of America in two Olympics and have done so successfully.
sentences.zh: 我曾代表美利坚合众国参加过两届奥运会并且取得了成功。

sentences.en: And both USA Gymnastics and the United States Olympic Committee have been very quick to capitalize and celebrate my success.
sentences.zh: 美国体操协会和美国奥林匹克委员会都非常急于利用我的成功并为之庆祝。

sentences.en: But did they reach out when I came forward?
sentences.zh: 但当我站出来时，他们联系过我吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 并没有。

sentences.en: After days of emotional testimony from female athletes, the organization that governs gymnastics in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在女运动员们进行了数日充满情感的作证后，管理美国体操运动的机构

sentences.en: announced that its chairman and several board members had resigned over their handling of sexual assault accusations against a team doctor.
sentences.zh: 宣布其主席和多名董事会成员因处理针对一名队医的性侵指控不当而辞职。

sentences.en: I am here to face you, Larry, so you can see I've regained my strength, that I'm no longer a victim, I'm a survivor.
sentences.zh: 我来这里是来面对你的，拉里，好让你看到我已经恢复了力量，我不再是受害者，而是一名幸存者。

sentences.en: After Dr. Lawrence Nassar pleaded guilty to molesting at least seven girls, dozens of gymnasts, including U.S.
sentences.zh: 在劳伦斯·纳萨尔医生承认对至少七名女孩实施猥亵后，包括美国

sentences.en: gold medalist Allie Raisman, stood up and recounted their experience at his sentencing hearing.
sentences.zh: 金牌得主阿莉·莱斯曼在内的数十名体操运动员站出来，在宣判听证会上讲述了她们的经历。

sentences.en: I was the innocent nine-year-old with a broken pelvis that was willing to trust and allow the doctor to do anything to help it feel better.
sentences.zh: 我当时是个骨盆骨折、天真无邪的九岁小孩，愿意去信任并允许医生做任何事情来减轻痛苦。

sentences.en: You convinced my parents that you didn't pull my feet into your lap, unzip your pants, and rub your erect penis against my bare skin.
sentences.zh: 你让我的父母相信，你没有把我的脚拉到你的大腿上，没有解开裤子，也没有将你勃起的阴茎摩擦我的光裸皮肤。

sentences.en: Now I get flashbacks when I see male hands, and it makes me feel scared and threatened.
sentences.zh: 现在当我看到男人的手时，我就会闪回那些画面，这让我感到害怕和受到威胁。

sentences.en: You used my body for six years for your own sexual gratification.
sentences.zh: 你为了你自己的性快感，利用了我的身体六年。

sentences.en: In their testimonies, Raisman and other female athletes had challenged USA Gymnastics to explain how so many women could have suffered this abuse for so many years.
sentences.zh: 在她们的证词中，莱斯曼和其他女运动员质问美国体操协会，为什么这么多的女性会遭受这种虐待长达多年。

sentences.en: USA Gymnastics, where is the honesty?
sentences.zh: 美国体操协会，诚实何在？

sentences.en: Where is the transparency?
sentences.zh: 透明度何在？

sentences.en: Why must the manipulation continue?
sentences.zh: 为什么操纵还要继续？

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulain.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Marc Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店当DJ的时候，你每夜都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个充满生机的、精美的50年历史文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。
